sources.quote: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is a text-only model that requires thinking mode for all interactions. Multimodal inputs are not supported, and thinking cannot be disabled.

unknown: SWE-Bench Pro (Scale, public V2): no Qwen row among the 11 rows of the Scale leaderboard read on 2026-10-03; the page shows no update date
Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index: no row for this model on Artificial Analysis's coding-agent leaderboard (read 2026-10-03), which lists Qwen3.8 Max only
METR 50% time horizon: METR's page (last updated 2026-05-08) mentions only 'Qwen models' (added 2025-06-27) and its chart values are not in the page text, so a Qwen3.x entry is not ruled out
Release date: maker changelog 2026-08-13, Artificial Analysis page 2026-08-12, Hugging Face repository created 2026-08-08 and last changed 2026-08-12; 2026-08-13 kept
context_window: 262,144 is the open weights' native figure; QwenCloud's hosted build lists 1M with 991K input
Benchmark rows: the maker's table is headed Qwen3.8-Max, the hosted build of 2026-08-03, so the figures are that build's and not a separate run of the open weights

max_output: 131,072 is the card's suggested reply length and the hosted output limit; QwenCloud's hosted page caps reasoning at 131K, half the card's 262,144 suggestion; in thinking mode max_tokens is capped at 32,768 (max_completion_tokens is not)
Artificial Analysis effort setting: the page does not name the effort it ran
system_card: none; the Hugging Face card carries benchmarks and best practices and no safety evaluation, and the maker may not publish one
